Favoured weapon: Whip

Granted power: Advantage on Persuasion. Once/day: one creature within 30ft that can see you is Charmed by you for 1 minute (Will save negates; it saves again whenever you or your allies harm it). Lay on Hands also ends the Charmed condition.
